title: Divina Proportione (Italian, 1509)
author: Luca Pacioli
description: Luca Pacioli examines proportion, geometry and their application to the arts. This historic Italian work is associated with the mathematical study of harmonious form and the significance of the divine proportion.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/divinaproportion00paci).
